```{r, include=FALSE}
# Create a df and add cols from meta_long

  dplyr::select(
    SampleID,
    subject_id,
    time,
    age,
    sex,
    race_3,
    ethnicity,
    Intervention,
    imf,
    prop_cal_diff_from_rx
  )

# Add time1 and time2 cols for later merging
meta_lmer_long <- meta_lmer_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time1 = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("\\.3m$", SampleID)  ~ 0,
      grepl("\\.6m$", SampleID)  ~ 3,
      grepl("\\.12m$", SampleID) ~ 6,
    ),
    time2 = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("\\.3m$", SampleID)  ~ 3,
      grepl("\\.6m$", SampleID)  ~ 6,
      grepl("\\.12m$", SampleID) ~ 12,
    )
  )

# remove BL measures
meta_lmer_long <- meta_lmer_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("\\.BL$", SampleID))

# add subject_id col for merging
meta_vol_long <- meta_vol_long %>%
  mutate(
    subject_id = sub("\\..*$", "", SampleID)
  )
```

```{r, include=FALSE}

# prepare categories
lmer_combined <- lmer_combined %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    subject_id = factor(subject_id),
    Intervention = factor(Intervention, levels = c("IMF", "DCR")),
    imf = factor(imf, levels = c("1", "0")),
    race_3 = factor(race_3),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("0", "1")),
    ethnicity = factor(ethnicity, levels = c("0", "1"))
  )


predictor_cols <- c(
  "vol.ait",
  "vol.un",
  "vol.wt",
  "vol.guni"
)

# create a new single column for each outcome from the wide format
lmer_combined <- lmer_combined %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_weight_change = dplyr::case_when(
      time2 == 3  ~ pchange_outcome_wt_fnl_3m_BL,
      time2 == 6  ~ pchange_outcome_wt_fnl_6m_3m,
      time2 == 12 ~ pchange_outcome_wt_fnl_12m_6m
    ),
    p_wc_change = dplyr::case_when(
      time2 == 3  ~ pchange_wc_average_3m_BL,
      time2 == 6  ~ pchange_wc_average_6m_3m,
      time2 == 12 ~ pchange_wc_average_12m_6m
    )
  )

# remove the change columns from wide format data
lmer_combined <- lmer_combined %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of(outcome_cols))

# create interval column using time1 and time2
lmer_combined <- lmer_combined %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    interval = factor(
      paste(time1, time2, sep = "-"),
      levels = c("0-3", "3-6", "6-12")
    )
  )

# standardize the predictor columns
lmer_standardized <- lmer_combined %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(predictor_cols),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))
    )
  )

# check standardization
lmer_standardized %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(predictor_cols),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  )

# Create a new df to be used in the models
lmer_data <- lmer_standardized

```



```{r, include=FALSE}

run_model <- function(data, measurement, outcomes) {
  # This function takes the df, the measurements, and the outomes 
  #then runs it through tidy and creates a seaparate DF for plots
  
  
  models <- map(
    outcomes,
    ~ lmerTest::lmer(
      as.formula(
        paste(
          .x,
          "~ age + sex + race_3 + ethnicity + interval +",
          measurement,
          "+ (1 | subject_id)"
        )
      ),
      data = data,
      na.action = na.omit
    )
  )

  names(models) <- outcomes
  
  print(map(models, lme4::isSingular))

  print(map(models, lme4::VarCorr))

  tidy_models <- map(
    models,
    ~ {
      model <- .x

      broom.mixed::tidy(
        model,
        effects = "fixed",
        conf.int = TRUE,
        conf.method = "Wald"
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          N = nobs(model),
          Participants = n_distinct(
            model.frame(model)$subject_id
          )
        )
    }
  )

  results <- bind_rows(
    tidy_models,
    .id = "Outcome"
  ) %>%
    filter(term == measurement) %>%
    mutate(measurement = measurement)

  return(results)
}

```


```{r, include=FALSE}

change_outcomes <- c("p_weight_change", "p_wc_change")

# run each predictor through run_model function created above
# 1 predictor values for 2 outcomes - EX: | p_weight_change | vol.ait | 
#                                         | p_wc_change     | vol.ait | 
change_results <- map_dfr(
  predictor_cols,
  ~ run_model(
    data = lmer_data,
    measurement = .x,
    outcomes = change_outcomes
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  change_results,
  caption = "Predictor associations with interval weight and WC percent changes"
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

predictor_labels <- c( 
            "Aitchison volatility",
            "Unweighted UniFrac volatility",
            "Weighted UniFrac volatility",
            "Generalized UniFrac volatility"
            )



outcome_levels <- c(
                  "p_weight_change", 
                  "p_wc_change"
                  #"WBTOT_fat_change",
                  #"HOMA_IR_change",
                  #"hemo_A1C_change"
                  )

outcome_labels <- c(
                  "Weight % Change",
                  "Waist Circ. % Change"
                  #"WBTOT_Fat",
                  #"HOMA_IR",
                  #"HEMO_A1"C
                  )


plot_lmer_results <- function(results, title, subtitle) {
  # plot results
  
  plot_data <- results %>%
    mutate(
      sig = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "Sig", "N.S."),
      Measurement = factor(
        measurement,
        levels = rev(predictor_cols),
        labels = rev(predictor_labels)
      ),
      Outcome = factor(
        Outcome,
        levels = outcome_levels,
        labels = outcome_labels
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Measurement,
      y = estimate
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = conf.low,
        ymax = conf.high
      ),
      width = 0.05,
      linewidth = 1,
      color = "#0072B2"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(shape = sig),
      size = 4,
      color = "#0072B2"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(~ Outcome) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "Sig" = 19,
        "N.S." = 1
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Volatility Measure",
      y = "Regression estimate",
      shape = "Statistical significance",
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 21, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
}


p <- plot_lmer_results(
  change_results,
  "Gut Microbiome Volatility and Clinical Outcomes",
  "Overall Across 0–3, 3–6, and 6–12 months
  (N = 329 | Parcipiants = 139)") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
  )

ggsave("volatility_transparent.png", p,
       bg = "transparent", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```


```{r, include=FALSE}

# Do the above for each intervention
intervention_results <- map_dfr(
  c("IMF", "DCR"),
  function(group) {

    group_data <- lmer_data %>%
      filter(Intervention == group)

    map_dfr(
      predictor_cols,
      ~ run_model(
        data = group_data,
        measurement = .x,
        outcomes = change_outcomes
      )
    ) %>%
      mutate(Intervention = group)
  }
)


plot_intervention_results <- function(results, title, subtitle) {

  plot_data <- results %>%
    mutate(
      sig = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "Sig", "N.S."),
      Intervention = factor(Intervention, levels = c("IMF", "DCR")),
      Measurement = factor(
        measurement,
        levels = rev(predictor_cols),
        labels = rev(predictor_labels)
      ),
      Outcome = factor(
        Outcome,
        levels = outcome_levels,
        labels = outcome_labels
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Measurement,
      y = estimate,
      color = Intervention
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
      width = 0.05,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(shape = sig),
      size = 4
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(Intervention ~ Outcome) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Sig" = 19, "N.S." = 1)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "IMF" = "#D55E00",
        "DCR" = "#0072B2"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Volatility Measure",
      y = "Regression estimate",
      shape = "Statistical significance",
      color = "Intervention",
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
}
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Overall adherence models using original, unstandardized values
adherence_results <- run_model(
  data = lmer_combined,
  measurement = "prop_cal_diff_from_rx",
  outcomes = change_outcomes
)

# Fit adherence models separately within each intervention
adherence_intervention_results <- map_dfr(
  c("IMF", "DCR"),
  function(group) {

    group_data <- lmer_combined %>%
      filter(Intervention == group)

    run_model(
      data = group_data,
      measurement = "prop_cal_diff_from_rx",
      outcomes = change_outcomes
    ) %>%
      mutate(Intervention = group)
  }
)

# Display model results
knitr::kable(
  adherence_results,
  caption = "Unstandardized adherence associations with clinical changes"
)

knitr::kable(
  adherence_intervention_results,
  caption = "Unstandardized adherence associations by intervention"
)


# Plot overall or intervention-specific adherence results
plot_adherence_results <- function(
    results, title, subtitle, split = FALSE) {

  plot_data <- results %>%
    mutate(
      sig = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "Sig", "N.S."),
      Measurement = "Calorie adherence",
      Outcome = factor(
        Outcome,
        levels = c("p_weight_change", "p_wc_change"),
        labels = c(
          "Weight percent change",
          "Waist circumference percent change"
        )
      )
    )

  if (split) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(
        Intervention = factor(
          Intervention,
          levels = c("IMF", "DCR")
        )
      )
  }

  plot <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = Measurement, y = estimate)
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey20"
    )

  if (split) {
    plot <- plot +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(
          ymin = conf.low,
          ymax = conf.high,
          color = Intervention
        ),
        width = 0.05,
        linewidth = 1
      ) +
      geom_point(
        aes(shape = sig, color = Intervention),
        size = 4
      ) +
      facet_grid(Intervention ~ Outcome) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "IMF" = "#D55E00",
          "DCR" = "#0072B2"
        )
      )

  } else {
    plot <- plot +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(
          ymin = conf.low,
          ymax = conf.high
        ),
        width = 0.05,
        linewidth = 1,
        color = "#0072B2"
      ) +
      geom_point(
        aes(shape = sig),
        size = 4,
        color = "#0072B2"
      ) +
      facet_grid(~ Outcome)
  }

  plot +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "Sig" = 19,
        "N.S." = 1
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Volatility Measure",
      y = "Regression estimate",
      shape = "Statistical significance",
      color = "Intervention"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```
